article.headline: Pelicans face the Nuggets on 3-game slide
article.description: Denver Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Pelicans face the Nuggets on 3-game slide
article.linkText: Pelicans face the Nuggets on 3-game slide
article.story: Denver Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 14th in the Western Conference) New Orleans; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: New Orleans will try to stop its three-game losing streak when the Pelicans take on Denver. New Orleans finished 26-56 overall, 17-34 in Western Conference action and 17-24 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans averaged 25.1 assists per game on 42.1 made field goals last season. Denver went 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 122.1 points per game last season, 20.8 from the free-throw line and 42.6 from beyond the arc. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Nuggets won 141-135 in overtime in the last matchup on Oct. 25. INJURIES: Pelicans: Yves Missi: day to day (knee). Nuggets: Alpha Diallo: out (wrist), Spencer Jones: out (hamstring), Cameron Johnson: out (ankle), Julian Strawther: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
